## 1. Overview

delta-force-core is a TypeScript/JavaScript npm package providing:

- Data: operators, weapons, equipment, ammo from the game Delta Force (三角洲行动)
- Random picking: getRandomLoadout(), getRandomWeapon(), getRandomOperator()
- Querying: findWeaponById(), findAmmoByCaliber(), etc.
- User overrides: inject your own quality ratings, aliases, tags at runtime
- MCP Server: for AI clients (Claude Desktop / Cursor / Cline)

Package: delta-force-core
Registry: https://registry.npmjs.org/delta-force-core
GitHub: https://github.com/Zhoyi011/delta-force-core
Wiki: https://github.com/Zhoyi011/delta-force-core/wiki
Raw JSON: https://unpkg.com/delta-force-core/index.json
License: MIT
Runtime deps: none (zero-dependency)
Node: >= 18

---

## 2. Installation

npm install delta-force-core

## 3. Import Patterns

// Lazy mode — use official data + default engine
import {
  getRandomWeapon,
  getRandomOperator,
  getRandomLoadout,
  getRandomAmmo,
  getRandomArmor,
  getRandomHelmet,
  getRandomBackpack,
  getRandomChestRig,
  findWeaponById,
  findOperatorById,
  findAmmoById,
  findWeaponsByCaliber,
  findAmmoByCaliber,
  findWeaponByAlias,
  listAllWeapons,
  listAllOperators,
  listWeaponCategories,
  listOperatorCategories,
  createEngine,
  defaultEngine,
  WEAPONS,
  OPERATORS,
  EQUIPMENT,
  AMMO,
} from 'delta-force-core';

---

## 4. Type Definitions

### Weapon

interface Weapon {
  id: string;              // e.g. "m4a1"
  name: string;            // e.g. "M4A1突击步枪"
  caliber?: string;        // e.g. "5.56x45mm"
  baseDamage?: number;     // raw gun damage
  description?: string;
  image?: string;          // URL to weapon image (png)
  allowNormal?: boolean;   // whether usable in Normal mode (default true)
}

NOTE: Official Weapon does NOT contain quality. Quality is user-injected.

### Operator

interface Operator {
  id: string;              // e.g. "honglang"
  name: string;            // e.g. "红狼"
  features?: string;       // e.g. "爆发移速"
  description?: string;
  image?: string;
}

### Ammo

interface Ammo {
  id: string;              // e.g. "ammo_556x45"
  name: string;            // e.g. "5.56x45mm"
  caliber: string;         // e.g. "5.56x45mm"
  description?: string;
  image?: string;
}

### EquipmentItem

interface EquipmentItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  features?: string;       // for armor/helmet
  comment?: string;        // for backpack/chest rig
  description?: string;
  image?: string;
}

### EquipmentTier

interface EquipmentTier {
  tier: number;            // 1..6
  allowNormal?: boolean;   // default true
  items: EquipmentItem[];
}

### Loadout

interface Loadout {
  operator: Operator;
  weapon: Weapon;
  armor: EquipmentItem;
  helmet: EquipmentItem;
  backpack: EquipmentItem;
  chestRig: EquipmentItem;
}

### WeaponQuality

type WeaponQuality = '绿色' | '蓝色' | '紫色' | '金色';
//                    green   blue    purple   gold

---

## 5. API — Random Picking

All pickers use Math.random(). Empty pool throws an error.

### getRandomOperator(category?: string): Operator

getRandomOperator();          // any operator
getRandomOperator('突击兵');   // assault only

Categories: '突击兵', '支援兵', '工程兵', '侦察兵'

### getRandomWeapon(options?: WeaponOptions): Weapon

interface WeaponOptions {
  category?: string;        // '突击步枪' | '冲锋枪' | ...
  quality?: WeaponQuality;  // requires qualityOverride on the engine
  allowNormal?: boolean;
}

getRandomWeapon();
getRandomWeapon({ category: '突击步枪' });
getRandomWeapon({ allowNormal: true });

### getRandomAmmo(options?: AmmoOptions): Ammo

interface AmmoOptions {
  caliber?: string;         // '5.56x45mm' | '7.62x39mm' | ...
}

### getRandomArmor/Helmet/Backpack/ChestRig(options?: TierOptions): EquipmentItem

interface TierOptions {
  tier?: number;            // 1..6
  allowNormal?: boolean;
}

### getRandomLoadout(options?: LoadoutOptions): Loadout

interface LoadoutOptions {
  allowNormal?: boolean;
}

const l = getRandomLoadout({ allowNormal: true });
// l.operator, l.weapon, l.armor, l.helmet, l.backpack, l.chestRig

---

## 6. API — Querying

findOperatorById(id: string): Operator | undefined
findWeaponById(id: string): Weapon | undefined
findAmmoById(id: string): Ammo | undefined
findArmorById(id: string): EquipmentItem | undefined
findHelmetById(id: string): EquipmentItem | undefined
findBackpackById(id: string): EquipmentItem | undefined
findChestRigById(id: string): EquipmentItem | undefined
findWeaponsByCaliber(caliber: string): Weapon[]
findAmmoByCaliber(caliber: string): Ammo[]
findWeaponByAlias(alias: string): Weapon | undefined  // requires aliasOverride

findWeaponById('m4a1');
// { id: 'm4a1', name: 'M4A1突击步枪', caliber: '5.56x45mm', allowNormal: true }

findWeaponsByCaliber('5.56x45mm');

---

## 7. API — Listing

listOperatorCategories(): string[]
// ['突击兵', '支援兵', '工程兵', '侦察兵']

listWeaponCategories(): string[]
// ['突击步枪', '冲锋枪', '精确射手步枪', '狙击步枪', '轻机枪', '霰弹枪', '手枪', '特殊武器']

listAllOperators(): Operator[]
listAllWeapons(): Weapon[]

---

## 8. API — Custom Engine

import { createEngine } from 'delta-force-core';

const engine = createEngine({
  qualityOverride: {
    m4a1: '金色',
    akm: '紫色',
  },
  aliasOverride: {
    m4a1: ['M4', 'M4卡宾枪'],
  },
  tagOverride: {
    m4a1: ['classic', 'beginner'],
  },
});

engine.getRandomWeapon({ quality: '金色' });
engine.getWeaponQuality('m4a1');         // '金色'
engine.findWeaponByAlias('M4');          // -> m4a1 weapon
engine.getAliases('m4a1');               // ['M4', 'M4卡宾枪']

IMPORTANT: Default engine has EMPTY overrides. getRandomWeapon({ quality: '金色' }) on default engine returns empty pool and throws. Use createEngine({ qualityOverride }) first.

---

## 9. Raw Data Exports

import { OPERATORS, WEAPONS, EQUIPMENT, AMMO } from 'delta-force-core';

OPERATORS: OperatorCategory[]
// [{ category: '突击兵', operators: [...] }, ...]

WEAPONS: WeaponCategory[]
// [{ category: '突击步枪', weapons: [...] }, ...]

EQUIPMENT: {
  armors: EquipmentTier[];
  helmets: EquipmentTier[];
  backpacks: EquipmentTier[];
  chest_rigs: EquipmentTier[];
}

AMMO: Ammo[]

  "operators": [...],
  "weapons": [...],
  "equipment": {...},
  "ammo": [...]

## 11. MCP Server

Install via npx (no manual install). Add to Claude Desktop / Cursor / Cline config:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "delta-force": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "-p", "delta-force-core", "delta-force-mcp"]
    }
  }
}

### MCP Tools

- get_random_loadout — random full loadout
- get_random_weapon — random weapon
- get_random_operator — random operator
- get_random_ammo — random ammo
- find_weapon — find weapon by id
- find_operator — find operator by id
- find_ammo — find ammo by id
- find_weapons_by_caliber — find weapons by caliber
- find_ammo_by_caliber — find ammo by caliber
- list_weapons — list all weapons (by category)
- list_operators — list all operators (by category)
- list_categories — list all categories

### MCP Resources

- delta-force://weapons
- delta-force://operators
- delta-force://equipment
- delta-force://ammo

---

## 12. Common AI Tasks

### Task 1: Generate a random full loadout

import { getRandomLoadout } from 'delta-force-core';
const l = getRandomLoadout({ allowNormal: true });
console.log(l.operator.name + ' / ' + l.weapon.name + ' / ' + l.armor.name);

### Task 2: List all weapons in a category

import { WEAPONS } from 'delta-force-core';
const cat = WEAPONS.find(g => g.category === '突击步枪');
console.log(cat.weapons.map(w => w.name));

### Task 3: Find weapons by caliber

import { findWeaponsByCaliber } from 'delta-force-core';
findWeaponsByCaliber('5.56x45mm');

### Task 4: Pick a gold-rarity weapon (custom rating)

import { createEngine } from 'delta-force-core';
const engine = createEngine({
  qualityOverride: { m4a1: '金色', k416: '金色' }
});
const w = engine.getRandomWeapon({ quality: '金色' });

### Task 5: Fetch all data without installing

const data = await fetch('https://unpkg.com/delta-force-core/index.json')
  .then(r => r.json());
console.log(data.weapons);

### Task 6: Discord.js bot integration

import { getRandomLoadout } from 'delta-force-core';
const l = getRandomLoadout();
interaction.reply({
  content: l.operator.name + ' / ' + l.weapon.name + ' / ' + l.armor.name
});

## 13. Data Summary

### Operators (17 total)

- 突击兵 (Assault): 红狼, 威龙, 疾风, 无名
- 支援兵 (Support): 蜂医, 蛊, 蝶, 旅人
- 工程兵 (Engineer): 牧羊人, 乌鲁鲁, 深蓝, 液氮, 比特
- 侦察兵 (Recon): 露娜, 骇爪, 回响, 银翼

### Weapons (68 total, 8 categories)

- 突击步枪 (Assault Rifles): 24
- 冲锋枪 (SMGs): 12
- 精确射手步枪 (DMRs): 10
- 狙击步枪 (Sniper Rifles): 5
- 轻机枪 (LMGs): 4
- 霰弹枪 (Shotguns): 5
- 手枪 (Pistols): 7
- 特殊武器 (Special): 1

### Ammo (21 calibers)

.357 Magnum, .45 ACP, .50 AE, .338, 12 Gauge, 12.7x55mm, 12.7x99mm, 5.45x39mm, 5.56x45mm, 5.7x28mm, 5.8x42mm, 6.8x51mm, 7.62x39mm, 7.62x51mm, 7.62x54mm, 9x19mm, 9x39mm, 4.6x30mm, .300 Blackout, 箭矢, 45-70 Govt

### Equipment

- Armor: tiers 1~6
- Helmet: tiers 1~6
- Backpack: tiers 1~6
- Chest rig: tiers 1~5
